action.details: Reproduces Fluent's generated PopClip action by sending the selected text and Fluent action identifier summarizeText through the FLNT/ACTN Apple event.
action.exampleInput: A long article or document excerpt that needs a short overview.
action.exampleOutput: Fluent runs Summarize on the selected text.

integration.name: Fluent
integration.summary: AI writing, translation, and editing actions powered by Fluent.

action.name: Fluent — Summarize
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text to Fluent on this Mac. Fluent then uses the local or cloud model configured in Fluent.
action.requirements: Fluent 1.7.1 or later must be installed and the corresponding built-in Fluent action must be available. macOS may ask you to allow ActionClip to control Fluent.
action.summary: Summarize the selected text using Fluent.
